lines.name: l1
lines.text: This private jet costs seventy million dollars. That's not the expensive part.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: Just to keep it flying, owners spend around eleven thousand dollars for every hour in the air.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: Fly it four hundred and fifty hours a year, and that's about five million dollars.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: Pilots, fuel, the hangar, insurance. Every single year.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: So the real question isn't if you can buy one. It's if you can afford to keep it.
